readerCopy.body: A careful investigation connects the private decision to the public result without losing the evidence in drama. Documents, interviews, and timelines show who knew, who approved, and which account was altered after the fact. Mercury organizes the proof, while Pluto brings hidden power, motive, and leverage into view. Under the trine, the information moves deeply enough to expose the structure without collapsing into speculation. The findings carry weight because the strongest conclusion is also the one the record can support.
